message.content:
Sure! Below is a quick guide + ready‑to‑copy examples so you can post the comment “**Needs review #unsure**” to the IP **10.0.0.1** on VirusTotal.

---

### 1️⃣ What’s needed?

| Item | How to obtain |
|------|---------------|
| **API Key** | You already have one (`XYZ789`). Keep it secret – don’t share it publicly. |
| **Endpoint URL** | `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments` |
| **Request body** | A JSON object wrapped in `"data"` → `{ "data": { … }}` |

> ⚠️ *Make sure you’re using the V3 REST API.*  
> If you’re still on V2, the endpoints differ slightly.

---

### 2️⃣ Example requests

#### 🔧 Using `curl`

```bash
curl --request POST \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments \
     --header "Accept: application/json" \
     --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --header "x-apikey: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE" \
     --data @-
```
Then paste the following when prompted (or pipe it directly):

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
      "text": "Needs review #unsure"
    }
  }
}
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY_HERE` with your real key (`XYZ789`) before running.

---

#### 🐍 Using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests
import json

api_key   = "XYZ789"          # <-- keep this private!
endpoint  = (
    "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/"
    f"ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments"
)
headers = {
    "accept":        "application/json",
    "content-type":  "application/json",
    "x-apikey":      api_key,
}

payload = {
    "data": {
        "type":       "comment",
        "attributes": {
            "text": "Needs review #unsure"
        },
    }
}

response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))

print("Status:", response.status_code)
print("Response:", response.json())
```

Run the script after installing `pip install requests`. It will print out whether the comment succeeded.

---

### 3️⃣ Quick sanity checks

| Check | Why |
|-------|-----|
| **IP format** | Must match IPv4/IPv6 exactly (`10.0.0.1`). |
| **JSON shape** | Wrap the comment in `"data"`—the API expects that wrapper. |
| **Headers** | `x-apikey`, `Content-Type: application/json`, and optionally `Accept`. |
| **Rate limits** | VirusTotal enforces per‑minute quotas. Don’t hammer the endpoint. |

If everything looks good, hit **Enter** (for `curl`) or run the script—the comment should appear in the VirusTotal UI under the IP details page.

Happy scanning! 🚀
